internalAccountId.description: The ID of the crypto internal account to withdraw from.

currency.description: The currency code of the asset to withdraw (e.g. USDC).

cryptoNetwork.description: The blockchain network for the withdrawal. Example values: SOLANA, ETHEREUM, BASE, POLYGON, SPARK, LIGHTNING, BITCOIN.

amount.description: The amount to withdraw in the smallest unit of the currency.

destinationAddress.description: The blockchain address to withdraw funds to.
